2608.19066.title: GS-VLA: Plug-and-Play Viewpoint Canonicalization for Frozen VLA Policies via Gaussian Splatting
2608.19066.paper_summary: This paper proposes a lightweight, plug-and-play framework that improves robustness to viewpoint shifts in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies without policy retraining. To our knowledge, this is the first approach to directly leverage 3D Gaussian-based novel-view synthesis for observation-space adaptation in VLA policies. Current VLA performance relies on the implicit assumption that training and deployment camera configurations are identical. Our experiments show that even a small displacement of the camera mount can reduce the success rate on the LIBERO benchmark from about 90% to about 10% in the worst case. Prior approaches, such as large-scale fine-tuning or generative data augmentation, are computationally expensive and risk catastrophic forgetting. To address this, viewpoint shifts are reformulated as a localized novel-view synthesis problem. Under a Locality assumption, that camera perturbations remain within a small bounded region relative to the workspace, viewpoint normalization reduces to a scene- and policy-independent disocclusion task. Our work implements this idea with a 4M-parameter 3D-Gaussian canonicalizer prepended to a frozen VLA policy. Without modifying policy weights, GS-VLA improves performance across three orthogonal axes: (1) Policy architectures, (2) Unseen task suites, and (3) Perturbation scales. These results show that a lightweight visual module can recover a large fraction of the performance lost under viewpoint shift, without policy retraining.
2608.19066.paper_summary_zh: 這篇論文提出了一個輕量級的即插即用框架，能在不重新訓練政策的情況下提高對視角變化的穩健性，應用於視覺-語言-行動（VLA）政策。據我們所知，這是第一個直接利用基於3D高斯的新視角合成來進行VLA政策觀察空間適應的方法。目前的VLA性能依賴於訓練和部署相機配置相同的隱含假設。我們的實驗顯示，即使是相機支架的微小位移，也能在最糟情況下將LIBERO基準的成功率從約90%降低至約10%。先前的方法，如大規模微調或生成數據增強，計算成本高昂且存在災難性遺忘的風險。為了解決這個問題，視角變化被重新表述為一個局部的新視角合成問題。在一個局部性假設下，即相機擾動保持在相對於工作空間的小範圍內，視角正規化簡化為一個場景和政策無關的去遮擋任務。我們的工作實現了這一思想，使用了一個4M參數的3D高斯標準化器，前置於一個凍結的VLA政策上。在不修改政策權重的情況下，GS-VLA在三個正交軸上提高了性能：（1）政策架構，（2）未見任務套件，以及（3）擾動尺度。這些結果顯示，輕量級的視覺模塊可以在不重新訓練政策的情況下，恢復在視角變化下損失的大部分性能。
2608.19066.author: Yechan Park et.al.
